name: Ratatui
description: Rust library for building terminal user interfaces.
summary: AI-assisted PRs are welcome if you say you used AI, review every line, keep the amount reasonable and check licence compatibility.

evidence.quote: Attribution: Tell us about your use of AI tools, don't make us guess whether you're using it.
Review: Make sure you review every line of AI generated content for correctness and relevance.
License: Ensure that the AI-generated content is compatible with Ratatui's
Remember that AI tools can assist in generating content, but you are responsible for the final quality and accuracy of the contributions and communicating about it.
